# Fanta Preformance Modpack
A super lightweight modpack for very low-end potato computers.
## Features
- ⚙️Super Lightweight
- ⚙️Popular Preformance mods
- ⚙️Bare bones Built in resource pack
 
- 🍹Supa Fast! go brrrrr
